# Harpreet Singh — Web Developer & Designer

> Harpreet Singh is a Web Developer and Designer with 4+ years of professional experience and 5+ delivered projects, specializing in WordPress, Elementor, responsive web design, landing pages and UI/UX design.

## Who this is
Harpreet Singh builds responsive, user-friendly, high-converting websites. Core stack: HTML, WordPress, Elementor, JotForm, Contact Form 7, Slider Revolution, Thrive, Figma. Also uses AI-assisted tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity, Google Flow) as part of the design and development workflow.

## Services
- Web Development — responsive, performance-focused websites
- WordPress Development — built with Elementor and related WordPress tools
- Website Design — UI/UX designed in Figma, developed responsively
- Landing Pages — conversion-focused campaign pages
- Forms & Integrations — JotForm, Contact Form 7 setups
- AI-Powered Web Solutions — AI-accelerated design and development workflows

## Experience
- 4+ years of professional experience
- 5+ professional projects completed
- Project types delivered: business websites, WordPress websites, landing pages, creative/portfolio websites, UI/UX-led websites
